agency: Kementerian Kesehatan RI ? Badan Kebijakan Pembangunan Kesehatan (BKPK)

source.title: Survei Status Gizi Indonesia (SSGI) 2024 Dalam Angka

method: Text extraction from the official SSGI 2024 PDF tables. Stunting is the first percentage column in each kabupaten/kota row. Rows were matched to 2026 dim_regions by normalized name, administrative level, and province; no values were imputed or fabricated.
notes: Applied as the full 514 kab/kota stunting series in the active LIVE snapshot. The previous snapshot remains immutable for audit.
